propwash.audio.motor_volume.tooltip: Volume of all drone motors. Applied on top of Minecraft's “Players” sound category. Drones you hear from outside get quieter with distance like real ones: a whoop fades out after about 20 blocks, a 5″ after about 70, an X-Class after up to 160.
propwash.audio.beep_volume.tooltip: Volume of the beeps for arming, low battery, gates and races. Releasing the slider plays a test beep.
propwash.audio.doppler.tooltip: Passing drones sound higher while approaching and lower while flying away.
propwash.audio.voice_limit.tooltip: This many drones (the ones you hear best first) get the live motor sound. All others play a simpler recorded sound. Minecraft has only 8 streaming channels, which music and records need too.
propwash.audio.synthesizer.tooltip: Computes the motor sound live from the drone's RPM, props and motors. Off: all drones play a simpler recorded sound (helps with crackling or a weak CPU).
propwash.audio.status: Playing now: %s with live sound (up to %s), %s with the simpler sound
propwash.audio.status.hint: Live sound is computed from RPM, props and motors. Above this limit, the faintest drones switch to a simpler recorded sound.
